recommendations.title: Create: Worked payback calculator example for a Stockholm villa
recommendations.details: Create a detailed worked-example article showing a step‑by‑step payback calculation for a typical Stockholm villa that includes assumptions (battery size, household consumption profile, spot price, effect‑tariff reduction, income from FCR‑D/aFRR, green tax credit). Show sensitivity scenarios (with/without solar, different tariff levels) and a downloadable summary table so homeowners can understand the numbers behind the 3–6 year payback claim.
